n1: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:Every AI assistant gets measured against one benchmark: Jarvis.
n2: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:So I built one that behaves like the original. It talks, and Claude builds the interface live. The hard part was keeping the agent on theme: real HUD components only, never a generic web page.
u1: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:Jarvis, put two minutes on the clock.
j1: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:Two minutes, sir. The countdown is up top.
u2: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:Plot a course to the Brandenburg Gate.
j2: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:Brandenburg Gate is one point five kilometres south-west, heading two one seven. It's on your map.
j3: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:Alphabet closed at three hundred and twenty dollars, down five percent this month. Chart's top left.
u4: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:Why is it down? Check the news.
j4: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:MarketBeat says Citizens JMP cut its target to four hundred and fifty dollars, and the AI sell-off is weighing on it. Earnings are on the twenty-eighth. Sources, top right.
j5: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:Berlin is overcast, ten degrees, wind fifteen kilometres an hour. Fine for flying. Lower right.
u6: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:Download the Mark Eight firmware and run a diagnostic.
j6: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:Firmware is in. Every thruster is above ninety percent, except the left boot at seventy-eight.
j7: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:Combat mode. Reticle is up, three targets locked, shields holding.
n3: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:Jarvis is just the costume for a hackathon. The point is generative UI in your own theme: an interface that rebuilds itself around whoever sits in front of it. Run it for yourself, or build it into your product. People are reverse-engineering SaaS tools to personalize them, and it's killing those companies. This could save them.
u8: nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb:Find where I set the left boot.
j8: mMc1jJdsmogeUDdTvGEf:Found it. Line twelve of thrusters dot toml caps the left boot at seventy-eight percent.
